name: Mint Sauce
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: finely powdered cut-loaf sugar
ingredients.originalText: two tablespoonfuls of finely powdered cut-loaf sugar

ingredients.name: six tablespoonfuls good cider or white-wine vinegar
ingredients.originalText: six tablespoonfuls good cider or white-wine vinegar
ingredients.quantityText: six tablespoonfuls good cider or white-wine vinegar

instructions.text: Wash and drain them or dry on a cloth
Add two tablespoonfuls of finely powdered cut-loaf sugar to three tablespoonfuls of mint
Mix and let it stand a few minutes
Pour over it six tablespoonfuls good cider or white-wine vinegar
Make some time before dinner so that the flavor of the mint may be well extracted

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Strip spearmint leaves from stems
2. Wash and drain them or dry on a cloth
3. Chop very fine
4. Put in a gravy tureen
5. Add two tablespoonfuls of finely powdered cut-loaf sugar to three tablespoonfuls of mint
6. Mix and let it stand a few minutes
7. Pour over it six tablespoonfuls good cider or white-wine vinegar
8. Make some time before dinner so that the flavor of the mint may be well extracted
